title: Cover messageDisposition compatibility and short peer batches
outcome: Review found two small contract gaps: ordinary non-peer message responses do not explicitly pin the intended messageDisposition behavior, and structured peerBatch UI tests cover only long collapsed messages, not the short non-collapsed render path.
acceptance: Tests explicitly document disposition behavior for ordinary sends and verify a short structured peerBatch renders with Peer queue attribution without collapse or text-prefix inference.
